headings.text: Zendesk named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for the CRM Customer Engagement Center
The Resolution Platform that scales with you
Continuously optimize with data and insights
Secure control that builds customer trust
How can we help? Contact us.

body: Connect AI, agents, knowledge, and workflows in Zendesk’s Resolution Platform to resolve customer requests faster and deliver more personalized support across every channel.
14-day free trial. No credit card required.

Enable agentic service that builds loyalty across all channels. Self-learning AI agents can automate up to 80% of interactions, improving with every resolution while keeping responses accurate and on brand.
“Zendesk AI agents are a game changer. It has turned our agents from widget movers into problem solvers.”
Senior Director of Service Quality at Best Egg
Enterprise-grade security and transparent AI governance protect data, ensure compliance, and build confidence at every step.
AI that continuously measures and optimizes performance, reducing errors and inconsistency for reliable, high-quality support.
Agentic AI works alongside teams, offering contextual assistance that enhances human expertise, keeping control while working smarter.
Combining AI, people, and knowledge in a single platform to deliver smarter, faster support from end to end.
Take a guided tour of our customer service solution and discover how AI, automation, and connected workflows help teams deliver faster, more personalized service.
Industry-leading security keeps sensitive information safe.
We're taking concrete steps toward net zero.
Zendesk named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™
Unlock the power of AI for customer experience
The humanizing power of AI in CX
Zendesk Secures Key Industry Recognition as its AI-First Strategy Gains Momentum
